hermit.name: A mysterious Hermit
hermit.dialogue: The world is falling out of balance. The Shattered Amulet must be reforged. Find the fragments in the world's most dangerous corners: the heart of the sky city, the deepest part of the desert, and the belly of the beast that sleeps in the sunken city.
